name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2013 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2013 record supports: the techniques ATT&CK lists for the objects it ties to 2013 reports or events, G0006 APT1 (the 22 entries that cite Mandiant's report of 19 February), G0044 Winnti Group (Kaspersky, 11 April), S0033 NetTraveler (Kaspersky, 4 June), G0094 Kimsuky (the 16 entries that cite Kaspersky's report of 11 September), S0051 MiniDuke (the entries that cite the 27 February reports), G0021 Molerats (FireEye, 23 August, as ATT&CK cites it), S0027 Zeroaccess (disrupted 5 December) and S0041 Wiper (the March 2013 South Korea attack), and behavior described by US-CERT's alerts on Java (TA13-010A), open DNS resolvers (TA13-088A) and CryptoLocker (TA13-309A), Microsoft's advisories and bulletins, Cloudflare's Spamhaus posts, Kaspersky's MiniDuke, NetTraveler and Icefog reports, the Drinkman indictment, the DOE Inspector General's report, ICS-CERT's 2013 incident record, the FBI's ransomware warnings, the 2016 indictment over the bank DDoS and, graded Reported, the 2014 Senate report on Target. No 2013 source prints an ATT&CK id. The four ATT&CK for ICS techniques are in the study's table, not in this layer. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2013.md. Scores: 100 an ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports it, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
